           TARTARICUM ACIDUM

         Tartaric Acid


Found in grapes, pineapple, sorrel and other fruits. It is an
        antiscorbutic antiseptic, stimulating the mucous and salivary secretions.


Dullness and lassitude. Great weakness, with diarrhœa, with dry and
        brown tongue. Pain in heels (  Phytol  ).



Stomach.--  Excessive thirst, continued vomiting burning in
        throat and stomach. Dyspepsia with copious secretions of mucus.



Abdomen.--  Pain around umbilicus and region of loins. Stool
        color of coffee-grounds (worse at night), with brown and dry tongue, and dark-green
        vomiting.



Dose.--  Third trituration. The pure acid 10-30 grains dissolved
        in water.
